title: Quality Studio integration capabilities v1
description: GET /api/v1/capabilities: what this Quality Studio host offers Agent Studio under the agent-studio-integration contract. A reader ignores features it does not know and degrades a surface whose feature is absent.

contracts.description: Integration contract versions this host implements, for example agent-studio-integration/1. A caller picks the highest version both sides support.

features.description: Optional parts of the contract this host has: federation (the Agent Studio hand-off receiver is configured), deep-link/1, and later external-ref and change-review-store.

versions.description: Hand-off assertion versions (claim ver) the receiver accepts.

spend.description: Whether routes that spend model tokens (review, change-review, handover) can reach a provider on this host. Without one they answer provider-unavailable while every read surface works.
